verdict.root_cause_reason: The report identifies the right component and mechanism: pricing-cache failover to a nearly empty replica caused the cold-cache miss storm. But it frames the primary root cause as a host hardware fault on pricing-cache-001, whereas the key’s root cause is the failover to the replica that was mid full-resync.
unsupported_claims: The warmer step that the runbook prescribes after a failover was not run.
